title: cotula mexicana
intro: Cotula mexicana, commonly known as Mexican pyrethrum, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Cotula mexicana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cotula mexicana include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
